name: krylov_cost_benzene
purpose: TASKS 133: what pyscf 2.14.0's CPHF Krylov (no lindep; master's #3333 fixed it) cost the closed-shell CC anchors - benzene CCSD(T)/cc-pVDZ's reference gradient (E8, the anchors' runner, fast (T) kernels) with the released CPHF and with master's swapped in for the Z-vector solve only, each solve's relative residual recorded; beyond 1e-6 a.u. the anchors' Hessians are re-checked through their energy route.

memory.basis: a bound: probes/wsl_capped.sh stops each of the two runs at 8192 MB (pyscf max_memory 6963); the two run one after the other

estimate.basis: the fused (T) density+lambda pass took 90 s for benzene/cc-pVDZ's lambda and gradient (7ab1b3a5, 30 Sep), besides SCF, CCSD and the CCSD lambda; two runs; TASKS 133 said about 30 min
